name: My Gemini Tools
description: Common Gemini data mounts, scripts, and lifecycle hooks
postCreateCommand: if [ -f /var/devcontainer-scripts/setup-gemini.sh ]; then bash /var/devcontainer-scripts/setup-gemini.sh; elif [ -f .devcontainer/setup-gemini.sh ]; then bash .devcontainer/setup-gemini.sh; fi
postStartCommand: if command -v backup-gemini >/dev/null 2>&1; then backup-gemini --sync; elif [ -f /var/devcontainer-scripts/backup-gemini.sh ]; then bash /var/devcontainer-scripts/backup-gemini.sh --sync; fi
